We have Hades design spec. Need compare netlist. We need detect deviations from intended design that make board behave differently. Could be design error, assembly/sourcing, tampering. Spec says known bug barometer reset/EOC pins mixed up is not anomaly. Need not report. Need inspect netlist.

First understand architecture. Hades top sheet power: XT60 BAT2, shunt R38 0.01 2512, INA219 U7, buck REG2 MIC26903, LDO REG1 LD39200. FCC STM32H753VITx FCC2, NAVC STM32F405RGTx NAVC2. Sensors: BMI088 U3, IIS2MDCTR U18, MPRLS U5, TMP100 U8, EEPROM U15, GPS U1. FCC peripherals: PCA9685 U4, W25N01 U17, EEPROM U2, connectors. Connections: USB micro, SWD, CH330? But netlist has no CH330 components? Wait spec says USB-UART bridges otter_CH330 x2 in Connections.sch. Netlist components list doesn't include any CH330/otter. Connections sheet has USB1/3/4/5, SWD2/3, diodes, LEDs, resistors, solder jumpers, but no UART bridge ICs. Is that anomaly? Maybe netlist omitted? But netlist authoritative. Spec says CH330 x2. If missing, could be anomaly? However maybe those are modules not in netlist? Let's inspect. Connections has USB connectors and series resistors to FCC2 USB pins? FCC2 has PA11/PA12 (USB D-/D+?) and PA13/PA14? Actually STM32 USB: PA11 USB_DM, PA12 USB_DP. Netlist: FCC2 pin70 PA11 -> R80? pin71 PA12 -> R4? USB4 D+/D-? Let's trace. USB4 D+ pin3 -> R78 -> FCC2 PA13? Wait pin72 PA13 is SWDIO normally, pin76 PA14 SWCLK. USB4: pin3 D+ -> R78 -> Net-(FCC2-PA13?) net 159: R78 pin2 to USB4 pin3, R78 pin1 to FCC2 pin72 PA13. USB4 pin2 D- -> R4 -> FCC2 pin71 PA12. That seems wrong: USB D+ tied to PA13 (SWDIO) and D- to PA12 (USB_DM?) Let's map: STM32H7 LQFP100: PA11 pin70 USB_DM? PA12 pin71 USB_DP? PA13 pin72 SWDIO, PA14 pin76 SWCLK. In netlist:
- net 159 Net-(USB4-D+) nodes R78 pin2, USB4 pin3. R78 pin1 is in net 57 NET0089: FCC2 pin72 PA13, R78 pin1. So USB4 D+ -> PA13.
- net 160 Net-(USB4-D-) nodes R4 pin2, USB4 pin2. R4 pin1 net 33 NET0052: FCC2 pin71 PA12, R4 pin1. So USB4 D- -> PA12.
- net 156 Net-(USB3-D+) nodes R9 pin2, USB3 pin3. R9 pin1 net 62 NET0095 only R9 pin1? Wait net 62 has only R9 pin1? It says (net code 62) NET0095 node R9 pin1. That's an open? Actually USB3 D+ via R9 to NET0095 single node? That seems dangling. USB3 D- via R59 to NET0140 single node? USB3 ID via R74 to NET0121 single node? Hmm.
- USB5 D+/D- unconnected. USB1 D+/D- unconnected. So USB4 is connected to FCC2? But wrong pins? Let's inspect FCC2 USB: PA11 (pin70) net 98 NET0148: FCC2 PA11, R80 pin1. R80 pin2 net 161 USB4-ID? Wait net 161: R80 pin2, USB4 pin4 ID. So PA11 connected to USB4 ID through 560? That seems odd. PA12 pin71 net 33: FCC2 PA12, R4 pin1. PA13 pin72 net 57: FCC2 PA13, R78 pin1. PA14 pin76 net 97: FCC2 PA14, SWD2 pin2 (SWCLK?). PA15 pin77 net 11: FCC2 PA15, SWD2 pin4. PA10 pin69 net 7: FCC2 PA10, JP4 pin2. PA9 pin68 net 21: FCC2 PA9, I2C3_FCC2 pin3, R20 pin2. PA8 pin67 net 8: FCC2 PA8, U17 DI.

Maybe USB4 is not connected to FCC's native USB? Wait FCC2 PA11/PA12 could be USB, but netlist shows PA11 to R80 to USB4 ID, PA12 to R4 to USB4 D-. PA13 to R78 to USB4 D+. That seems swapped and using ID pin. But maybe PA11/PA12 are not USB; PA11/PA12 could be used for UART? Need check spec: FCC has USB DFU? It says programming/debug via SWD, USB DFU, UART-to-USB. FCC2 likely uses PA11/PA12 for USB? But netlist connections maybe to CH330? There is no CH330. Could be deliberate? Need evaluate anomalies.

Let's systematically inspect all sections.

Spec:
- Power input XT60-M BAT2: pin1 -, pin2 +. Net VIN+ has BAT2 pin2, R38 pin2, U7 pin1 VIN+. Good. GND has BAT2 pin1, U7 pin3 GND, REG2 PGND etc.
- Shunt R38 value 0.01, footprint 2512. Good. Net 75 NET0113 includes R38 pin1, U7 VIN- pin2, REG2 PVIN pins, VIN, C9/C106, R3 pin1. So battery current through shunt to regulator input. U7 VIN+ on VIN+ battery side, VIN- on regulator input side. Good.

That may be a layout issue not netlist? The schematic net merges SGND and PGND at REG2? But spec says layout note, not necessarily net. Could be anomaly? Need careful: In schematic, SGND and PGND separate? The netlist has single GND net including both. But spec says keep SGND and PGND separate - connect only at one location. - Buck output: SW pins net 77 NET0116 includes L2 pin1, C70 pin1, BST cap C110 pin1, CS. L2 pin2 +5V. BST pin20 C110 pin2 D4 K. D4 A net 121 includes C69, R52 pin2, REG2 VDD. R52 pin1 NET0010? Maybe R5/R6 are divider from output to FB and FB to GND. But netlist shows R13 from +5V to FB, R67 from FB to GND. That yields Vout = 0.8*(1+R13/R67)=0.8*(1+6800/1300)=0.8*6.23=4.98V. Good. Net 216-220 unconnected-(FCC2-VDD-Pad11) etc. NAVC2 VDD pins unconnected too! This is huge: MCUs not powered? Let's inspect: FCC2 pins 11,27,50,75,100 VDD are unconnected individual nets.
